about.metaDescription: FindYourDent helps Patients in Indonesia understand their dental problem and choose a credible, affordable dentist.
about.title: Understand your dental problem, then choose a dentist with confidence.
about.lead: FindYourDent is a dentistry platform for Indonesia. We help Patients understand their dental problem and choose a credible, affordable dentist, and we give dentists and clinics a public identity.
about.builtFor: Built for the AI Builder Cup 2026.

what.title: Guidance for your problem
what.body: Describe your problem in your own words, typed or as a voice note. We explain how urgent it is, what it may be, the visits it usually takes, why prices vary, and BPJS coverage.

what.title: Straight to the IGD when danger signs appear
what.body: When danger signs appear, such as facial swelling with fever or difficulty swallowing, we send you to the nearest hospital emergency department first, ahead of anything else.

what.title: Dentists near you that fit
what.body: A list of dental clinics, private dentists and hospitals near you, with Patients’ Testimonies and price signals.

what.title: Testimonies from real patients
what.body: Patients write about their visit: service, hygiene, materials and equipment, and the price they paid.

about.safeLead: Gemini helps with the work that needs judgement. Anything that must never be wrong is handled by fixed rules and curated data.

safe.title: Danger signs are checked first
safe.body: The danger-sign check runs before any AI call, and the AI can never lower its urgency.

safe.title: Costs and BPJS from official sources
safe.body: Cost estimates, BPJS coverage and safety rules come from knowledge files that cite their regulation, not from the AI model.

safe.title: Your complaint is not stored
safe.body: Neither typed complaints nor voice notes are stored. A shared guidance link contains only the guidance, never your complaint.

safe.title: People make the decisions
safe.body: The AI publishes clean Testimonies and holds doubtful ones. The FindYourDent team decides on every held or reported Testimony. The AI never deletes.

about.goLead: We start in Indonesia because it is where we best understand Patients, dentists and the care system, including BPJS. Going forward, we plan to expand FindYourDent worldwide in stages, starting with the Asia Pacific region.

roadmap.title: Indonesia
roadmap.body: Guidance, emergency (IGD) escalation, the Directory and Testimonies for Patients across Indonesia, in Indonesian and English.

roadmap.title: Asia Pacific
roadmap.body: A step-by-step expansion into Asia Pacific countries, adapted to each country’s languages, health care system and rules.

roadmap.title: Worldwide
roadmap.body: Bringing the same approach to more countries, one at a time.

about.roadmapNote: Each new country opens only once its cost guidance, coverage information and safety rules are built from that country’s official sources.
principles: Educational and navigation information, not a diagnosis or a prescription.
No promotion, advertising, discounts or paid ranking. Dentists are never ranked by payment.
Practices can reply to or report a Testimony, but cannot delete or hide it.
about.contactBody: For partnerships and business enquiries, email the FindYourDent team.

verification.metaDescription: Only Testimonies with an accepted proof of visit shape ratings, order and prices on FindYourDent. Read how we check proof and our Testimony rules.
verification.title: How we verify Testimonies
verification.lead: Ratings on FindYourDent are only useful if they come from visits that really happened. That is why only Testimonies with an accepted proof of visit count. You can still read every other Testimony.
verification.countTitle: Only Testimonies with a verified visit count

count.title: Verified visit
count.body: A Testimony whose proof of visit was accepted. Only these count toward the service, hygiene, and materials and equipment ratings, the Directory order and the list of dentists near you, and the price stats.

count.title: Not yet verified
count.body: A Testimony without an accepted proof of visit is still published and can be read, labelled Not yet verified. It changes no rating, order or price.

count.title: At least {{min}} verified Testimonies
count.body: A star average appears only once a practice has {{min}} Testimonies with a verified visit. Until then it shows Not enough verified Testimonies yet, with their count.

count.title: One rule for everyone
count.body: Every practice is rated under this rule, including Testimonies published before it took effect. There is no paid ranking.

verification.checkTitle: How a proof of visit is checked
verification.checkLead: A proof of visit is a receipt, invoice or appointment card, as an image or a PDF. Attach it when you write your Testimony, or later from My Testimonies.
checkSteps: AI reads your document: whether it is readable, and whether it really shows a visit to a dental practice.
We match the clinic name on the document with the place you wrote about, and its date with the visit month you entered. The document must be less than 12 months old.
If everything matches, your Testimony is marked Verified visit. If something is doubtful, the FindYourDent team checks it, and your Testimony stays published as Not yet verified while it waits.
If the document is unreadable, is not a proof of visit, or is too old, you see the reason and can try another document.
One proof counts for one Testimony only. We keep a digital fingerprint of the proof, not the document, so one receipt cannot be used again and again.
verification.keepTitle: How long the proof file is kept

keep.title: Never shown
keep.body: A proof of visit is private. A Testimony shows only its mark: Verified visit or Not yet verified.

keep.title: Deleted after the check
keep.body: The proof file is deleted right after it is accepted or turned down. If our team needs to look at it, the file is kept privately for at most 7 days, then deleted.

keep.title: Your name is not recorded
keep.body: From the document we record only the clinic name, the date and the total, with its digital fingerprint. Your name on the document is never recorded.

keep.title: Deleted with your Testimony
keep.body: If you delete your Testimony, the record and fingerprint of its proof are deleted too.

verification.policyLead: A Testimony can only be trusted if it is written freely. These rules apply to FindYourDent and to every practice on it.
policy: FindYourDent never pays for or rewards Testimonies.
A practice may not offer anything in exchange for a Testimony, such as money, a discount, a gift or free treatment.
A practice may not ask only selected Patients, such as only satisfied ones, to write a Testimony.

A confirmed violation is shown publicly on that practice’s page with a Testimony policy violation mark, and the Testimonies from that period stop counting. Before a decision, the practice is told and can explain.
verification.reportTitle: Offered something in exchange for a Testimony?
verification.reportBody: Tell the FindYourDent team by email. Include the practice’s name and what was offered.

privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.lead: What data we collect, why, and how you stay in control. In short: your complaint and location are not stored.

sections.title: Who we are
blocks: FindYourDent is a dentistry platform for Indonesia operated by [legal entity name]. This policy explains what data we collect, why, how long we keep it, and your rights.
For privacy questions, contact us at <email/>.

sections.title: What we collect and why
blocks: Your dental complaint, typed or as a voice note, is used to write your Guidance. It is not stored and is never logged.
Your location or area is used only to find dentists near you and is not stored. In the Directory, distance is computed on your device and your location is not sent to us.
Your Google account is used when you write a Testimony or claim a page. Your account is never shown.
Testimonies: ratings, story, month and year of visit, the name you choose, and the procedure, price and photos if you add them. These are public. Location data in photos is removed automatically.

Proof of visit is deleted after the check, or within 7 days if our team needs to look at it. It is never shown; only a Verified visit mark appears if it is accepted. From it we keep only the clinic name, date and total printed on it, never your name.
Owner claim data: your SIP or practice permit is kept private and deleted after the decision. Your phone number is only for the FindYourDent team and is never shown.
Owner price lists: the original file is kept privately for 30 days in case of disputes, then deleted. Only rows the owner confirms are shown.
Reports on a Testimony: the category and details you write, for the team to review.

sections.title: Cookies
blocks: We use one cookie, __session, to remember your language, keep you signed in, and keep your Guidance session. It is kept for up to a year if you choose a language or sign in with Google.
We do not set advertising cookies.

sections.title: Security and abuse prevention
blocks: We use App Check with Google reCAPTCHA Enterprise to prevent abuse. To limit request rates, we store a random value that cannot be turned back into your IP address, token or session ID.

sections.title: AI and service providers
blocks: Your complaint is processed by Google AI (Gemini on Vertex AI) outside Indonesia.
Practice details, opening hours, Google ratings and reviews come from Google Maps.
Sign-in uses Google Firebase Authentication.
Testimonies, photos and account data are stored on Google Cloud in Jakarta.
We do not sell your personal data.

sections.title: How long we keep data
blocks: Complaints and location: not stored.
Proof of visit: deleted after the check, or within 7 days if our team needs to look at it.
Claim documents: deleted after the decision.
Original price list files: 30 days.
Testimonies: while published, until you or the team delete them.
The __session cookie: up to one year.

sections.title: Your rights
blocks: You can edit or delete a Testimony at any time from My Testimonies. Deleted text and photos are gone permanently.
To ask for a copy, correction or deletion of other data about you, email <email/>. We will reply within [time period].

sections.title: Changes to this policy
blocks: When this policy changes, we update the date at the top of this page. We will show important changes on the site before they take effect.

terms.title: Terms of use
terms.lead: The rules for using FindYourDent, for Patients, Testimony writers, and practice owners and dentists.

sections.title: Accepting these terms
blocks: By using FindYourDent, you agree to these terms of use and our Privacy policy. If you do not agree, please do not use the service.

sections.title: Not a medical service
blocks: FindYourDent gives educational and navigation information, not a diagnosis or a prescription. Guidance does not replace an examination by a dentist.
Cost estimates are a general picture, not a price quote from any practice.

sections.title: Emergencies

blocks.box: If you have danger signs, such as swelling of the face or neck, fever, difficulty swallowing or breathing, or bleeding that does not stop, go to the nearest hospital emergency department (IGD) now. Do not wait for a dentist appointment.

blocks: FindYourDent does not monitor your condition and does not contact emergency services for you.

sections.title: Accounts
blocks: You sign in with a Google account when you write a Testimony or claim a page. You are responsible for activity on your account. Each Patient can write one Testimony per practice.

sections.title: Rules for writing a Testimony
blocks: A Testimony must be:
your own experience, written honestly;
free of other people’s personal data, such as phone numbers, addresses, ID numbers, or the full names of patients or staff;
free of accusations stated as fact and of harassment;
not an advert, link, promo code, or someone else’s story;
not medical advice for readers, such as medicine names and doses;
about the right practice.
Photos may only show the waiting room, treatment room, equipment or signboard, with no faces, receipts or screenshots.

sections.title: Moderation
blocks: Every Testimony is screened. The AI publishes clean Testimonies, asks you to fix specific parts, or holds them for review. The FindYourDent team decides on every held or reported Testimony, usually within 24 hours, and may take it down if it breaks the rules. The AI never deletes a Testimony.
You can edit or delete your Testimony at any time.

sections.title: For owners and dentists
blocks: Claiming a page needs a SIP or practice permit and a phone check by the FindYourDent team.
Practice details and replies are checked before they are shown.
In line with the dental code of ethics, there is no promotion, advertising, discounts or paid ranking. A claim does not change how dentists are ranked.
Practices can reply to or report a Testimony, but cannot delete or hide it.
Owners are responsible for the accuracy of the price lists they confirm.

sections.title: Information from others
blocks: Ratings, reviews, opening hours and place details from Google Maps are shown as they are, with their source. FindYourDent does not change or guarantee that information.

sections.title: Rights to content
blocks: You keep ownership of the Testimonies and photos you send. By sending them, you allow FindYourDent to show them on this service. [The scope of this permission needs legal review.]

sections.title: Limitation of liability
blocks: [This section needs to be written by legal counsel.] Treatment decisions remain yours and your dentist’s.

sections.title: Governing law
blocks: These terms are governed by the laws of the Republic of Indonesia. [Needs legal review.]

sections.title: Changes and contact
blocks: When these terms change, we update the date at the top of this page. For questions, contact <email/>.
